title.suggested: Mace and Allen Plan Sparring Tour

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Tom Allen and Jem Mace, still in New Orleans, planned a sparring tour once Allen's arm healed, and that Mrs. Allen had left St. Louis to join him, carrying his championship belt.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads Daily Democrat, Sunday Morning, May 15, 1870. Same text was reprinted the next day (article 403).

facts.fact: Allen stayed in New Orleans recovering from the arm injury suffered against Mace; he and Mace planned an exhibition in New Orleans and then an extended sparring tour through the country
Mrs. Allen left St. Louis for New Orleans to join her husband, taking the belt presented to him by his St. Louis friends

notes: Date of Mrs. Allen's departure inferred: 'On Thursday' in the May 15 (Sunday) paper = May 12. Also notes J. L. Hughes's challenge with forfeit posted at Tom Allen's saloon, and returning fans calling the fight square. Current title says the tour began; it was only planned.
